title: I built a full 2.5D roguelite auto-battler in pure Vanilla JS + Canvas using LLMs as a pair programmer
author: detskiii
selftext:
Link: [https://diasuleimen.itch.io/guidless](https://diasuleimen.itch.io/guidless)

Over the past few months, I’ve been building **Guildless**, a browser-based tactical roguelite auto-battler. Instead of going with Unity or Godot, I decided on a somewhat masochistic constraint: zero external game engine, pure Vanilla JavaScript, and the HTML5 Canvas 2D API

I worked alongside LLMs (Antigravity + Gemini 3.8 flash only) as an active pair programmer throughout the entire development

  
Engine**:** Custom canvas renderer with pseudo-isometric projection

Game Loop: Decoupled combat tick rate with spatial grid collision, mass-based knockback physics, and a state machine for multi-phase bosses
